# noqeri/fs 0.5.0

Archive traversal guards, lexical child-path checks and bounded portable slash normalization; symlinks must be separately checked by the host.

The 0.1.1 exports are retained. License: MIT. This version is experimental until compiled and executed with the native Noqeri SDK. Host integration and OS-level safety are not implied by byte-level guards.

See `src/fs.noqeri`, and `tests/depth_regression.noqeri`.
